title: Massive Russian Attack Kills At Least 22, Devastates Pryluky Apartment Block

content: A Starlink trial on an Italian hilltop connected an ordinary smartphone to the Internet without mobile coverage, a satellite dish, or an external antenna. title: Impoverished Afghans Sell Kidneys On The Black Market 'Out Of Sheer Desperation'
content: Impoverished Afghans are illegally selling their kidneys to repay debts and buy food. The selling of organs comes as the war-torn country grapples with one of the world’s largest humanitarian crises.

title: Deep Debt, Failing Health: Afghans Desperate To Escape Poverty Sell Kidneys To Survive
content: As millions of Afghans struggle just to afford food, some have turned to selling one of their last remaining resources: a healthy kidney. The costs can be devastating: One woman said her health has deteriorated since she sold a kidney for a modest sum that failed to clear her family's debts.

title: Oil Tanker Hit By Naval Drones Near Sochi, Sparking Massive Fire On Black Sea
